title: Cross-source reconciliation: CMC vs CoinGecko
text: subtle important detail: two providers label physical instant different dates. two instants essentially moment time (differ 1 second), date labels disagree one day. first convention standard asset-pricing convention (CRSP, Compustat, Liu/Tsyvinski/Wu 2022 academic work): , close[X] / close[X-1] - 1 return earned date X. cg_history() cg_history_by_id() ship date_convention = "end_of_day" default, shifts CG’s midnight-UTC ticks -1 day output lines CMC’s labels. Pass date_convention = "raw" keep CG’s native start--day labels (useful diagnostic work directly CoinGecko UI public API).

code: # Pro tier nominal cap: 500 req / min. Stay below ~ 6 req / s. pro_sleep <- 0.2  pro_get <- function(path, query = NULL) {   url <- paste0("https://pro-api.coingecko.com/api/v3/", sub("^/", "", path))   resp <- httr::GET(     url,     query = query,     httr::add_headers(`x-cg-pro-api-key` = CG_PRO_KEY),     httr::timeout(60)   )   sc <- httr::status_code(resp)   if (sc == 429) {     ra <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(       httr::headers(resp)[["retry-after"]]))     if (is.na(ra)) ra <- 30     Sys.sleep(ra)     return(pro_get(path, query))  # one retry on 429   }   if (sc < 200 || sc >= 300) return(NULL)   jsonlite::fromJSON(httr::content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")) }

title: CoinGecko Pro backfill: one-shot survivorship-bias archive
text: Pro endpoint /coins/list?include_platform=false&status=active,inactive returns every coin CoinGecko ever tracked, active . input survivorship-bias-corrected universe. enrich numeric CoinGecko IDs, page /coins/markets:
code: pro_id_mapping <- function() {   raw <- pro_get("coins/list",                  query = list(include_platform = "false",                               status = "active,inactive"))   if (is.null(raw) || !length(raw)) return(tibble::tibble())   tibble::tibble(     slug         = raw$id,     symbol       = raw$symbol,     name         = raw$name,     harvested_at = Sys.Date()   ) }  mapping <- pro_id_mapping() nrow(mapping) #> [1] ~ 17 000 (active) + 5 000-10 000 inactive pro_numeric_ids <- function() {   per_page <- 250L   pages <- vector("list", 200L)   for (i in seq_along(pages)) {     Sys.sleep(pro_sleep)     page <- pro_get("coins/markets",                     query = list(vs_currency = "usd",                                  per_page = per_page, page = i))     if (is.null(page) || !nrow(page)) break     pages[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(       slug   = page$id,       id     = as.integer(sub("^.*/coins/images/([0-9]+).*$", "\\1",                               page$image)),       rank   = page$market_cap_rank     )     if (nrow(pages[[i]]) < per_page) break   }   dplyr::bind_rows(pages) }  ids <- pro_numeric_ids() mapping_full <- dplyr::left_join(mapping, ids, by = "slug")

title: Get historic crypto currency market data from CoinGecko — cg_history
text: coin_list string NULL retrieve currently existing coins (cg_list()), provide list crypto currencies cg_list() / cg_listings() format. convert (default: "USD"). aware CoinGecko free tier typically supports "USD" "BTC" reliably. limit integer Return top n records, default tokens. start_date, end_date date Filter returned timeseries date window fetching. interval string Always coerced "daily" – CoinGecko website endpoints return daily granularity full-history pulls. Hourly available without API key. requestLimit Kept parity crypto_history() – ignored (CoinGecko returns full history per coin one call). sleep integer (default 0) Seconds sleep API requests. internal client enforces polite floor stay within CoinGecko's per-minute budget. wait waiting time retry case fail (default 60). finalWait Sleep 60s last call (mirrors crypto_history()). single_id Kept parity crypto_history() – ignored; CoinGecko endpoints always single-coin per call. date_convention Either "end_of_day" (default) "raw". CoinGecko's native daily series timestamps point 00:00:00 UTC date X, physical instant 23:59:59 UTC date X-1 – .e. CG labels start--day rather close--day. CMC (crypto_history()) label instant date X-1 (day just ended), also standard asset-pricing convention used CRSP/Compustat major academic datasets. "end_of_day" (default) cg_history() shifts CG's midnight ticks -1 day close[X] / close[X-1] - 1 return earned date X, matching CMC. Pass "raw" keep CG's native start--day labelling.

Cronjob-style accumulation: persist cg_list() snapshots time, union numeric IDs ever observed survivorship-bias-corrected universe. cg_history_by_id() lets refetch historical ID directly without needing current slug still resolve. Important caveats – please read: numeric-ID space sparse, dense. Blind iteration 1:N recover full universe – numeric IDs range data. default ids = NULL therefore uses active universe cg_list(), numeric range. recover delisted coins must supply IDs explicitly (e.g., union accumulated cg_list() snapshots, historic mapping cg_id_mapping()). Slug recovery delisted coins generally available free tier. Active coins get slug/name joined back cg_list(); rows whose numeric ID longer active universe come back slug = NA name = NA. title: crypto2 2.1.0.9000 (development version)
text: Added CoinGecko-side counterpart CMC API second, independent source. Column names mirror crypto_* functions, downstream code already consumes CMC tibble works CG tibble . cg_list() – active coin universe; signature matches crypto_list(). only_active = FALSE, transparently extends universe historic mapping cg_id_mapping() prints one line indicating current mapping . cg_listings() – current cross-sectional snapshot; signature matches crypto_listings(). = "latest" supported free tier; "new" / "historical" warn coerce. cg_history() – daily OHLC + volume + market-cap history; signature matches crypto_history(). Missing numeric ids silently backfilled historic mapping. cg_info() – per-coin metadata; signature matches crypto_info(). cg_history_by_id() – companion cg_history() addresses coins numeric CoinGecko id rather slug, useful refreshing coins whose slug longer resolves. cg_id_mapping() – reads periodically-refreshed (id, slug, symbol, name, harvested_at) archive (cached tempdir(), small bundled fallback inst/extdata/). Used internally cg_list(only_active = FALSE) cg_history(); can also called directly. CG-specific knobs CMC counterpart (rate-limit floor, retry budget, OHLC-stream selection) move package options: crypto2.cg_sleep, crypto2.cg_wait, crypto2.cg_max_retries, crypto2.cg_top_n, crypto2.cg_what, crypto2.cg_vs_currency. keeps public signatures aligned CMC functions.

title: crypto2 2.1.0.9000 (development version)
text: cg_history() cg_history_by_id() now harmonize date labels crypto_history() default. CoinGecko’s native daily series timestamps point 00:00:00 UTC date X, physical instant 23:59:59 UTC date X-1 – CMC (standard asset-pricing convention used CRSP / Compustat / Liu, Tsyvinski & Wu 2022) labels instant date X-1, CG labels date X. Empirically, CG’s row labelled date X agrees CMC’s row labelled date X-1 within sub-dollar precision (verified hourly intraday CG data; see tools/check_cg_midnight_convention.R). New argument date_convention = c("end_of_day", "raw") cg_history() cg_history_by_id(), defaulting "end_of_day". default, midnight-UTC ticks attributed previous date close[X] / close[X-1] - 1 return earned date X, matching CMC. Pass date_convention = "raw" keep CG’s native start--day labels.
